description: Benchmark power system base case with multiple DC links in multi-infeed configuration is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Francisco Damasceno Freitas, Jefferson Carlos Tavares Oliveira de Lima (Universidade de Brasília). Benchmark power system base case with multiple DC links in multi-infeed configuration, designed for steady-state studies and other simulations. The test system was developed from a network equivalent of the Brazilian power system based on recent data. Coverage: national (BR); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
